description.en: Deinosuchus inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m art envelope, not life size. Deinosuchus genus Fig6 whole outline and deep elongate robust crocodilelike skull combined with D. hatcheri CM963 holotype inflated osteoderms Fig2 and text (Mohler et al2021). Judith River Formation Montana Campanian armor identity. Not complete CM963 skeleton or species-specific skull measurements. Width qualitative. Soft tissue, scute arrangement/count, teeth count, feet, pose and color artistic.
